description: For the items of a shopping list, finds products that do the same job for less: a bigger pack that costs less per kilogram, litre or piece, or another brand of the same kind of product. Each swap says how much cheaper it is per unit and what it saves on the item's quantity.

country.description: The country whose stores to read: UZ (Uzbekistan), KZ (Kazakhstan), RU (Russia), US (United States), GB or UK (United Kingdom).

name.description: The item as a shopper writes it ("milk 1 l", "eggs", "paracetamol 500 mg").

productId.description: A product id from search_products, to compare exactly that product.

lang.description: Language of texts and amounts in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag (en, ru, uz, uz-Cyrl, kk, es, …). Default: the assistant's locale, else the country's main language.
